# persistence failure restores previous state

    raise RuntimeError("db down")

    pass

    advance(job2, State.COMPLETE, lambda j: None)

    pass

    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

# success unchanged

assert saved == [j3] and j3.state is State.RUNNING

# failure after starting leaves state intact
j4 = Job("j4")
try:
    advance(j4, State.RUNNING, lambda j: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError()))
except RuntimeError:
    pass
